name: cdp5-agents
description: CDP5 agents for the engineering loop: judgment and counter-roles (konzept-reviewer, review-verify, adversarial-auditor, threat-modeler, mcp-security-reviewer, devils-advocate, pessimistic-realist, review-code, pm-retro), implementation workers (impl-debug, impl-uc, impl-refactor) and the orchestrate skill for the main session. Ships the shared worker contract (SubagentStart injection; SubagentStop acknowledgement, hedged-claim check and usage log), a PreToolUse tripwire on Bash and PowerShell (allowlist: judgment agents read-only unless a run grant names a disposable environment, workers off commit, push and history rewrites), a SessionStart bootstrap for the main session, and the scripts worktree-setup (worktree on a base commit, green baseline, grant) and grant-run.
